properties.notes: Site of former hotel that is now out of use and offers a chance for redevelopment for residential units. Permitted scheme for 10 units is yet to commence (17/02068/FUL). This encompasses redevelopment of the hotel into apartments and provision of new-build semi-detached mezzanine bungalow and completion is anticipated for the next 5 years . A previous proposal for 12 dwellings was refused in November 2015, with an appeal subsequently dismissed (14/03794/FUL).
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
